                                                                                                   Functional Description




4. Functional Description

4.1 Wi-Fi/Bluetooth Transceiver
The BK7258 integrates a high-performance Wi-Fi/Bluetooth transceiver. The transceiver incorporates two on-chip
baluns. On the receive side, the on-chip balun converts the single-ended (unbalanced) RF signal from the
antenna into a differential (balanced) signal and the low noise amplifier (LNA) amplifies the differential signal to
achieve a better noise and linearity trade-off. On the transmit side, the power amplifier (PA) amplifies the
differential signal and the on-chip balun converts the differential signal to a single-ended signal for feeding the
antenna. This enables transmit and receive operations with only one ANT pin connected to the antenna. The
communication range can be extended by configuring GPIO26 and GPIO28 as TX_EN and RX_EN function to
control external PA and LNA. The frequency synthesizer is fully integrated, eliminating the need for any external
components.



4.2 Bluetooth/Wi-Fi Coexistence
The built-in packet traffic arbitration (PTA) ensures stable Bluetooth and Wi-Fi dual connectivity and enables
efficient sharing of over-the-air resources.



4.3 Clock Management
The primary clock sources available in the BK7258 are as follows:

•    High-frequency clocks

     -    26 MHz crystal oscillator: it outputs clock signal XTALH
     -    26–360 MHz internal digitally controlled oscillator (DCO): it outputs clock signal CLK_DCO
     -    Digital PLL (DPLL): it generates 320 MHz clock CLK_320M and 480 MHz clock CLK_480M
•    Low-frequency clocks

     -    32 kHz (32.768 kHz) crystal oscillator: it outputs clock signal XTALL

     -    32 kHz internal ring oscillator (ROSC): it outputs clock signal CLK_ROSC
•    Audio clock

     -    Audio PLL (APLL): its default frequency is 98.304 MHz, and it outputs clock signal CLK_APLL
The system generates a low-power clock source LPO_CLK for standby. The LPO_CLK can be selected from the
following clocks:

© 2023-2025 Beken Corporation                              60                                      DS-BK7258-E12 V2.1
                                                                                               Functional Description


•    32 kHz crystal oscillator XTALL
•    32 kHz clock signal derived from 26 MHz crystal oscillator

•    32 kHz internal oscillator ROSC
The BK7258 also has a clock output capability, which allows clock signals to be output to external components
through GPIOs. GPIOs can output the following clock signals:

•    CLK13M: clock derived from CLK_XTAL (division factor 1/2/4/8)
•    CLK26M: high-frequency crystal clock CLK_XTAL, generally 26 MHz
•    LPO_CLK: LPO_CLK clock

•    I2S_MCLK: reference clock for external audio codec, derived from APLL

•    CLK_AUXS_CIS: reference clock for external CMOS image sensor (CIS)

•    CIS_MCLK: reference clock for external CMOS image sensor (CIS)



4.4 Reset
A reset can be triggered by the following sources: power-on reset, brown-out reset, watchdog reset, and wake-up
from shutdown mode or deep sleep mode.

Power-on reset, brown-out reset, and AWDT watchdog reset reset the whole chip to its initial state. The DWDT
watchdog reset’s reset scope is configurable and can be configured to reset the whole chip.

Wake-up from shutdown mode triggers the whole system reset, while wake-up from deep sleep mode triggers the
reset of digital blocks.



4.5 Power Management

4.5.1 Power Scheme
The power management system on the BK7258 includes two buck converters and several internal LDO regulators
to provide voltage and noise isolation to various parts of the chip.

The VBAT is the external main chip supply ranging from 2.5 to 4.35 V. The VBAT generates VIO through the IO
LDO regulator. In addition to being the power supply for Wi-Fi PA and GPIOs, the VIO is also the input supply of
analog LDO, analog buck, digital buck, and EXMEM LDO. The VBAT also generates VDDA and VDDD through
the analog buck converter and the digital buck converter, respectively. The LDOs and bucks generate the
following main power supplies:

       VCCIF to supply power to the Wi-Fi/Bluetooth transceiver, and internally provides power to XTAL and AUDIO
       directly.
•      VDDDIG: power supply for digital domain. It provides power supply for the processor, memory, Wi-Fi and
       Bluetooth basebands, as well as various peripherals.
•      VDDRAM: power supply for PSRAM.

4.5.2 Power Modes
The BK7258 supports three low-power modes except active mode, namely shutdown mode, deep sleep mode,
and sleep mode, among which the shutdown mode has the lowest power consumption.

Shutdown Mode: All circuits are turned off. A high level on the CEN pin will bring the system to active mode.

Deep Sleep Mode: All circuits are powered down except the AON block. A GPIO event, an RTC event, or a touch
sensor event can power up the system again. The retention register holds its content.

Sleep Mode: The MCU and all digital blocks stop their clocks. A GPIO event, an RTC event, a touch sensor event,
a Wi-Fi MAC counter event, or a Bluetooth MAC counter event can bring the system back to active mode with
normal voltage.

Active Mode: The MCU is active, and all peripherals are available.



4.6 General-purpose I/Os (GPIO)
The BK7258 has up to 56 GPIOs, which can be configured as either input or output. All GPIOs are shared with
alternate functions. Table 3-5 Pin Multiplexing provides the mux functions of GPIOs.

The main features of GPIOs include:

•        Push-pull
•        Internal pull-up/down resistors
•        Configurable drive strength

•        Alternate function

•        Interrupt generation:

         -   High or low level

         -   Rising or falling edge




© 2023-2025 Beken Corporation                            65                                   DS-BK7258-E12 V2.1
                                                                                            Functional Description



4.7 SPI Interfaces (SPI)
The BK7258 integrates two SPI interfaces that can operate in master or slave mode. The SPI interfaces allow a
clock frequency up to 40 MHz in both master and slave modes.

The SPI interfaces support the following features:

•   4-wire or 3-wire full-duplex synchronous communication
•   Configurable 8-bit or 16-bit data width
•   Programmable clock polarity and phase
•   Programmable data order with MSB-first or LSB-first shifting

•   Embedded 64-depth RX FIFO and 64-depth TX FIFO with DMA capability



4.8 Quad SPI Interfaces (QSPI)
The BK7258 embeds two Quad SPI interfaces that provide support for communicating with external flash, PSRAM,
or AMOLED display. The QSPI interfaces allow communicating up to 80 MHz.

The features of the QSPI interfaces are listed below:

•   Single, dual, or quad SPI input/output

•   Two functional modes: indirect mode and memory-mapped mode

•   Fully programmable opcode and frame format

•   Integrated RX FIFO and TX FIFO
•   Supports 8, 16, and 32-bit data accesses



4.9 UART Interfaces (UART)
The BK7258 includes three Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter (UART) interfaces, which support
full-duplex, asynchronous serial communication at a baud rate up to 6 Mbps.

The UART interfaces offer the features below:

•   Configurable data length (5, 6, 7, or 8 bits)

•   Even, odd, or none parity check
•   Programmable stop bits (1 or 2 bits)

•   Each UART embeds a 128-byte TX FIFO and a 128-byte RX FIFO. FIFO mode is disabled by default and can
    be enabled by software.
•   Hardware flow control with RTS and CTS signals (UART0)

© 2023-2025 Beken Corporation                           66                                  DS-BK7258-E12 V2.1
                                                                                                 Functional Description


•   Flash download (UART0)
•   Programmable digital filter



4.10 Smart Card Controller (SC)
The Smart Card controller (SC) is a communication controller that transmits data between the superior system
and the Smart Card. The controller can perform a complete smart card session, including card activation, card
deactivation, cold/warm reset, Answer to Reset (ATR) response reception, data transfers, etc.

The features of the Smart Card controller (SC) are listed below:

•   Supports the ISO/IEC 7816-3:2006 and EMV 4.3 specifications
•   Performs functions needed for complete smart card sessions, including:

    -    Card activation and deactivation
    -    Cold/warm reset

    -    Answer to Reset (ATR) response reception
    -    Data transfers to and from the card
•   Extensive interrupt support system
•   Adjustable clock rate and bit (baud) rate
•   Configurable automatic byte repetition

•   Handles commonly used communication protocols:

    -    T=0 for asynchronous half-duplex character transmission, and

    -    T=1 for asynchronous half-duplex block transmission
•   Automatic convention detection

•   Adjustable FIFOs for Receive and Transmit buffers (64 bytes) with threshold
•   Configurable timing functions:

    -    Smart card activation time

    -    Smart card reset time
    -    Guard time

    -    Timeout timers




© 2023-2025 Beken Corporation                            67                                     DS-BK7258-E12 V2.1
                                                                                                   Functional Description



4.11 SDIO Interface (SDIO)
A secure digital input/output (SDIO) host/slave interface is available on the BK7258. It can be used as a host to
read external SD cards or used by an external host as a slave to communicate with chips. The SDIO interface
allows a maximum clock speed of 80 MHz.

The SDIO features include the following:

•    SD memory card specification version 2.0 compliant

•    SDIO card specification version 2.0 compliant

•    Two data bus modes: 1-bit mode (default) and 4-bit mode

•    Data transfer up to 40 Mbyte/s for the host mode and 20 Mbyte/s for the slave mode

•    Supports DMA capability, allowing high-speed transfer without CPU load



4.12 I2C Interfaces (I2C)
I2C is a popular inter-IC interface that requires only two bus lines, the serial data line (SDA) and the serial clock
line (SCL). The BK7258 embeds two I2C interfaces, which can operate in master or slave mode.

The features of the I2C interfaces are listed below:

•    Master and slave modes

•    Standard mode (up to 100 kbps)

•    Fast mode (up to 400 kbps)

•    7-bit and 10-bit addressing
•    Bus idle and SCL low timeout condition detection

•    Embedded 16-byte TX FIFO and 16-byte RX FIFO



4.13 USB Controller (USB)
The BK7258 embeds a USB high-speed (up to 480 Mbps) controller with an integrated transceiver. It can operate
as a host or a device.

The USB controller features are the following:

•    Compliant with the Universal Serial Bus Specification Rev 1.1 and 2.0

•    Full-speed (FS) operation (up to 12 Mbps) and high-speed operation (up to 480 Mbps)
•    One bidirectional control endpoint0
•    Seven IN/OUT endpoints configurable to support bulk, interrupt or isochronous data transfer

© 2023-2025 Beken Corporation                              68                                      DS-BK7258-E12 V2.1
                                                                                                 Functional Description


•   A FIFO of 8 Kbytes configurable to be allocated to 8 endpoints
•   USB 2.0 Link Power Management (LPM) support



4.14 CAN Controller (CAN)
The BK7258 embeds a Controller Area Network (CAN) controller that uses the basic CAN principle and meets all
constraints of the CAN-specification 2.0B active. Furthermore, the CAN controller can be configured to meet the
specification of CAN with flexible data rate CAN FD. CAN 2.0 carries a data payload up to 8 bytes and CAN FD up
to 64 bytes.

The CAN controller supports two operating modes, normal and standby, which can be selected via the
CAN_STBY pin. If a high level is applied to the CAN_STBY pin, the external transceiver enters the standby mode.



4.15 LIN Controller (LIN)
The Local Interconnect Network (LIN) controller is a communication controller that performs serial communication.
It implements the data link layer of the LIN Protocol Specification. The LIN protocol uses a single master/multiple
slave concept for the frame transfer between nodes of the LIN network.

The LIN controller supports Sleep mode. If a low level is applied to the LIN_SLEEP pin, the external transceiver
enters the Sleep mode.

The features of the LIN controller are listed here:

•   Support of LIN specification 2.2A
•   Backward compatibility to LIN 1.3

•   Configurable for support of master or slave functionality

•   Programmable data rate between 1 kbit/s and 20 kbit/s (for master)
•   Automatic bit rate detection (for slave)
•   8-byte data buffer

•   8-bit host controller interface



4.16 GDMA Controllers (GDMA)
The BK7258 has two general-purpose DMA controllers (GDMA) with 8 DMA channels each to unload CPU activity.
The 8 channels are shared by peripherals that have DMA capabilities.




© 2023-2025 Beken Corporation                            69                                     DS-BK7258-E12 V2.1
                                                                                                Functional Description


The GDMA controllers can perform single block transfers and repeated block transfers. Data width for destination
and source can be configured as 8 bits (byte), 16 bits (half-word), or 32 bits (word). The GDMA controllers allow
peripheral to memory, memory to memory, and memory to peripheral data transfers at a high speed.

The GDMA controllers support channel isolation. The DMA channels can be configured as secure/non-secure and
as privileged/unprivileged channels:

•   A non-secure channel performs non-secure DMA transfers

•   A secure channel can perform secure or non-secure DMA transfers, with

    -    Secure or non-secure data read from the source address

    -    Secure or non-secure data write to the destination address

    -    Via a TrustZone-aware DMA AHB master port
•   An unprivileged channel performs unprivileged DMA transfers
•   A privileged channel performs privileged DMA transfers

A selection of peripherals on the BK7258 have DMA capabilities, including UART0, UART1, UART2, SPI0, SPI1,
SDIO, AUDIO, I2S0, I2S1, I2S2, JPEG encoder, DISPLAY, AUX ADC, H.264, and DMIC.



4.17 DMA2D Controller (DMA2D)
The BK7258 has a specialized DMA controller (DMA2D) dedicated to image processing, offering direct memory
transfer and 2D graphical acceleration without CPU intervention. It can perform the following operations:

•   Filling a part or the whole of a destination image with a fixed color

•   Copying a part or the whole of a source image into a part or the whole of a destination image

•   Copying a part or the whole of a source image into a part or the whole of a destination image with a pixel
    format conversion

•   Blending a part or two complete source images with a different pixel format and copying the result into a part
    or the whole of a destination image with a different color format
The DMA2D controller supports six operating modes:

•   Register to memory

•   Memory to memory
•   Memory to memory with pixel format conversion

•   Memory to memory with pixel format conversion and blending
•   Memory to memory with pixel format conversion, blending and fixed color foreground layer
•   Memory to memory with pixel format conversion, blending and fixed color background layer




© 2023-2025 Beken Corporation                             70                                   DS-BK7258-E12 V2.1
                                                                                                 Functional Description


Up to 12 input color modes are supported from 4-bit up to 32-bit per pixel with indexed or direct color coding. Six
output color modes including RGB, ARGB, and YUV are supported. The DMA2D features dedicated memories for
color lookup table (CLUT) storage.

An interrupt can be generated on the following events:

•   Configuration error

•   CLUT transfer completion

•   CLUT access error
•   Watermark on a user programmable destination line
•   Transfer completion

•   Transfer error



4.18 Rotation Module (ROTT)
The rotation module (ROTT) is capable of performing the following operations:

•   Convert a YUV422 image stored in memory to a RGB565 image.

•   Rotate a YUV422 or RGB565 image by 90° in either clockwise or counterclockwise direction.
•   Store the converted or rotated image into the target memory.



4.19 Scaling Modules (SCALE)
The BK7258 has two scaling modules (SCALE) that can scale images of Y0UY1V, RGB565, or RGB888 format
without changing the data format.



4.20 Display Controller (DISPLAY)
The TFT LCD display controller (DISPLAY) provides a 24-bit parallel digital RGB (Red, Green, Blue) and outputs
all signals to interfaces of various LCD and TFT panels. It supports both RGB and Intel 8080 interfaces.

The display controller has the following features:

•   Supports RGB and Intel 8080 interfaces

•   RGB interface: up to 24-bit RGB parallel pixel output

•   8080 interface: up to 18-bit data output
•   Three input color formats:

    -    RGB888


© 2023-2025 Beken Corporation                            71                                     DS-BK7258-E12 V2.1
                                                                                              Functional Description


        -   RGB565
        -   YUV422
•       Three output color formats for RGB interface:

        -   RBG888

        -   RBG666
        -   RBG565
•       Three output color formats for 8080 interface:

        -   8- or 16-bit RGB888

        -   18-bit RGB666

        -   8-bit RGB565
•       RGB interface and 8080 interface share a FIFO (1K x 32-bit)
•       Programmable clocks for different display panels

•       Up to five programmable interrupt events

•       Configurable window position and size
•       AHB master interface with burst of 64 words



4.21 Segment LCD Controller (SLCD)
The segment LCD controller (SLCD) is a digital driver for monochrome passive-matrix liquid crystal display (LCD).
The controller drives up to 8 common terminals and 32 segment terminals to drive up to 128 (4x32) or 224 (8x28)
pixels. When using 4 common terminals, it supports 1/4 duty. The bias mode can be configured as 1/3 bias or 1/4
bias.



4.22 JPEG Encoder/Decoder
The BK7258 includes a JPEG encoder and a JPEG decoder for encoding and decoding JPEG streams. The
JPEG encoder provides a small hardware compressor for JPEG images, while the decoder provides a
decompression accelerator for JPEG images. Additionally, the JPEG encoder supports up to 32 programmable
quantization tables.

1: # Beken Genie AI Solution DEMO Development Guide
2: 
3: * [中文](./README_CN.md)
4: 
5: ## 1 Project Overview
6: 
7: This project is a general-purpose AI device solution framework based on the BK7258 chip, providing complete end-to-cloud and cloud-to-large-model AI interaction capabilities. The project supports Agora RTC solution, integrating audio processing engine, network transfer module, event management system, and rich peripheral support. It is suitable for developing intelligent AI devices, voice assistants, smart speakers, and other application scenarios.
8: 
9: ## 2 Features
10: 
11: ### 2.1 Real-time Audio/Video Communication
12: - Supports bidirectional audio/video communication
13: - Supports multiple audio/video streams
14: - Supports adaptive bitrate control (BWE)
15: - Supports key frame request mechanism
16: 
17: ### 2.2 Audio Processing
18: - Supports multiple audio encoding formats:
19:   - OPUS (recommended)
20:   - PCM
21: - Supports AEC (Acoustic Echo Cancellation)
22: - Supports NS (Noise Suppression)
23: - Supports KWS (Keyword Wake-up)
24: - Supports audio capture and playback
25: - Supports prompt tone playback
26: 
27: ### 2.3 Video Processing (Optional)
28: - Supports H264 encoding
29: - Supports JPEG encoding
30: - Supports video capture and transmission
31: - Supports image recognition
32: 
33: ### 2.4 Network Functions
34: - Supports WiFi STA mode connection
35: - Supports WiFi AP mode hotspot
36: - Supports Bluetooth network configuration
37: - Supports TCP/UDP protocols
38: - Supports HTTP/HTTPS requests
39: 
40: ### 2.5 AI Agent Integration
41: - Supports integration with multiple AI Agent services
42: - Supports voice conversation and image recognition
43: - Supports Agent start, stop, and update
44: - Supports starting Agent from BK server or custom server
45: - Supports multiple large language models (OpenAI, Doubao, DeepSeek, etc.)
46: 
47: ### 2.6 Room Management
48: - Supports joining/leaving RTC rooms
49: - Supports user online/offline notifications
50: - Supports Token permission management
51: - Supports Token expiration warning and automatic refresh
52: 
53: ### 2.7 Peripheral Support
54: - **Display**: Supports dual SPI LCD screens (GC9D01 160x160)
55: - **Input**: Microphone, buttons, gyroscope, NFC
56: - **Output**: Speaker, LED effects, vibration motor
57: - **Storage**: SD NAND 128MB
58: - **Power**: Lithium battery, charging management (ETA3422)
59: - **Camera**: DVP camera (gc2145)
60: 
61: ## 3 Quick Start
62: 
63: ### 3.1 Compilation and Flashing
64: 
65: Compilation process reference: `AI Solution <../../README_CN.md>`_
66: 
67: Flashing process reference: For specific `flashing procedures <https://docs.bekencorp.com/arminodoc/bk_avdk_smp/smp_doc/bk7258/en/v3.1.1/get-started/index.html>`_, please refer to `SMP <https://docs.bekencorp.com/arminodoc/bk_avdk_smp/smp_doc/bk7258/en/v3.1.1/index.html>`_
68: 
69: The compiled firmware bin file path: ``projects/beken_genie/build/bk7258/beken_genie/package/all-app.bin``
70: 
71: **Compilation command example:**
72: 
73: ```bash
74: cd ~/armino/bk_solution_ai/projects/beken_genie
75: export SDK_DIR=~/armino/bk_avdk_smp
76: make clean
77: make bk7258
78: ```
79: 
80: ## 4 API Reference
81: 
82: This section provides API interface descriptions for core functions in the project.
83: 
84: ### 4.1 Agora RTC API
85: 
86: If Agora RTC is enabled (`CONFIG_AGORA_RTC_EN=y`), the following APIs can be used:

88: #### 4.1.1 bk_agora_start

91:  * @brief Start complete Agora RTC and Agent service
92:  * 
93:  * @param device_id Device ID string
94:  *

20: # BK7258 AP 移植 openvela 实施与验证方案
21: 
22: > 文档状态：源码交叉验证后的实施基线。本文区分“已由当前仓库证实”“工程假设”和“量产前待原厂确认”。在 BK7258 专属安全启动、OTP/eFuse 和 CPU1 镜像认证资料闭环前，本文只能指导功能性 AP 移植，不能作为量产安全作业指导书。
23: 
24: ## 1. 目标和结论
25: 
26: 本文给出在 BK7258 上运行 openvela 的可执行移植方案。目标是保留现有 CPU0/CP 固件、bootloader、分区和低层芯片服务，将运行在全芯片 CPU1+CPU2 上的 AP SMP 固件替换为 openvela/NuttX，并完成可启动、可调度、可交互和可打包的内核适配。首版允许先在 AP primary core（物理 CPU1）上完成单核 bring-up，但这只是降低调试复杂度的实验路径，正式 AP 兼容目标仍是 CPU1+CPU2 SMP。
27: 
28: 架构结论必须先固定：BK7258 AP 是 Cortex-M33/ARMv8-M Mainline Thumb，不是 Cortex-A/ARMv8-A。移植必须使用 `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm`、NVIC、SysTick 和 MPU；任何 `arch/arm64`、GIC、AArch64 exception level、generic timer、MMU/页表、TF-A/BL31 或 `OUTPUT_ARCH(aarch64)` 方案均不适用。安全模型应讨论 TrustZone-M、SAU/IDAU、PPC/MPC 和可能的 TF-M，而不是 TF-A/EL3。
29: 
30: 本文只采用一条正式实现路径，不把以下做法作为交付方案：
31: 
32: - 不修改 CP 固件来绕过 AP 启动等待。
33: - 不把 openvela 与 FreeRTOS/Armino AP 固件混链。
34: - 不使用只发送 ready 的临时 mailbox 驱动。
35: - 不通过构建后覆盖临时 `app1.bin` 的方式集成 AP 镜像。
36: - 不在 Secure/Non-secure 地址之间运行时自动选择。
37: - 不关闭 MPU、FPU 来回避架构问题。
38: - 不让 AP 自己初始化 PSRAM。
39: 
40: 正式结论如下：
41: 
42: | 全芯片核 | 正式角色 | 本方案处理方式 |
43: | --- | --- | --- |
44: | CPU0 | CP、系统控制核、原 FreeRTOS 固件 | 原样保留 |
45: | CPU1 | AP primary core，当前 AP 固件第一启动目标 | 首版按现有 SPE 配置验证单核 openvela bring-up；实际安全状态必须实测 |
46: | CPU2 | AP secondary，AP SMP 的第二执行核 | 是否可在首版持续保持 reset 必须由启动链和实板确认；正式兼容目标启用 NuttX SMP |
47: 
48: AP 原 FreeRTOS 工程内部把物理 CPU1 称为逻辑 `core0`，把物理 CPU2 称为逻辑 `core1`。这只是 AP SMP 内部的编号，不能用于替代全芯片 CPU 编号。单核 bring-up 时 openvela 只运行逻辑 CPU index 0，BK mailbox 和系统控制固定使用物理 CPU1 对应资源；进入正式 SMP 阶段后必须建立逻辑 CPU 0/1 与物理 CPU1/CPU2 的稳定映射，并分别处理私有 NVIC、cache、TCM 和跨核启动。
49: 
50: ### 1.1 结论可信度
51: 
52: | 结论 | 状态 | 当前依据或约束 |
53: | --- | --- | --- |
54: | CPU1 是 Cortex-M33、ARMv8-M、hard-float AP 目标 | 已证实 | BK7258 CPU1/AP defconfig 和工具链 |

66: | AP 可直接擦写 Flash | 不成立 | AP 的 Flash 擦写依赖 mailbox/CP 服务；XIP读取与擦写编程必须分开设计 |

86: 
87: ## 2. 资料和代码依据
88: 
89: ### 2.1 openvela 移植规范
90: 
91: 新平台应按 Architecture、Chip/SoC、Board 三层组织，芯片层负责启动、中断、串口、定时器、堆和芯片寄存器，板级层负责链接脚本、GPIO、控制台和板级初始化：
92: 
93: - `openvela/docs/zh-cn/chip_porting/porting_guide.md:13-29`
94: - `openvela/docs/zh-cn/chip_porting/porting_guide.md:83-114`
95: - `openvela/docs/zh-cn/chip_porting/porting_guide.md:452-539`
96: 
97: openvela 已提供 ARMv8-M 公共实现，不应重写 Cortex-M33 的上下文切换：
98: 
99: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/armv8-m/Make.defs:21-45`
100: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/arm_m/Make.defs:21-50`
101: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/arm_m/arm_vectors.c`
102: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/armv8-m/arm_initialstate.c`
103: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/armv8-m/arm_doirq.c`
104: 
105: 完整 Cortex-M33 参考平台使用 STM32L5，最小 ARMv8-M/NSH 配置参考 MPS2 AN521：
106: 
107: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/stm32l5/`
108: - `openvela/nuttx/boards/arm/mps/mps2-an521/configs/nsh/defconfig`
109: 
110: ### 2.2 BK7258 芯片和三核架构
111: 
112: BK7258 是三核 Cortex-M33 AMP 系统。当前工作区没有原稿所引用的 `bk_idk/docs/bk7258/` 文档目录，因此不能继续把这些路径作为证据；可复核依据改为源码配置：
113: 
114: - `bk_idk/middleware/soc/bk7258/bk7258.defconfig`
115: - `bk_idk/middleware/soc/bk7258_cp1/bk7258_cp1.defconfig`
116: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap.defconfig`
117: - `bk_idk/middleware/soc/bk7258_cp1/compile-options.cmake`
118: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/compile-options.cmake`
119: 
120: 三个核的资源和角色：
121: 
122: - CPU0 是主核，负责系统控制和主日志输出。
123: - CPU1 通过 mailbox 与 CPU0 通信，主要承载多媒体/AP业务。
124: - CPU1和CPU2组成AP SMP；外设中断可路由到任一物理核，USB等外设的默认路由不能替代正式资源表。
125: - CPU1/AP 编译属性为 `-mcpu=cortex-m33+nodsp -mfpu=fpv5-sp-d16 -mfloat-abi=hard -mcmse`。
126: - 频率上限、TCM容量等产品参数在缺失正式 BK7258 文档时只作为待确认参数，不能作为链接或 timer 的硬编码输入。
127: 
128: ### 2.3 `vendor_beken` 参考适配的适用边界
129: 
130: 当前 `vendor_beken` 只包含 BK7236N：
131: 
132: - `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/`
133: - `vendor_beken/boards/bk7236n/bk7236n-evb/`
134: 
135: 可复用的是 custom chip/board 组织、Make/CMake 接入模式、`uart_ops_s`、SysTick lower-half，以及用强符号将 BK ISR 注册 ABI 接入 NuttX 的思路：
136: 
137: - `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/Kconfig`
138: - `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/Make.defs`
139: - `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/CMakeLists.txt`
140: - `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/beken_irq.c`
141: - `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/beken_interrupt_base.c`
142: - `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/beken_timerisr.c`
143: - `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/beken_uart.c`
144: 
145: 不得直接复用 BK7236N 的 `bootloader.bin`、`libs/*.a`、IRQ header、UART0 配置、链接脚本和 `bootloader + nuttx_crc.bin` 拼接工具。现有 `beken_head.S` 未被 Make/CMake 源列表可靠加入，链接入口又可能来自预编译 startup 库，因此它只能说明 legacy magic 的布局，不能作为已验证的 BK7258 reset 模板。
146: 
147: ### 2.4 AVDK AP/CP 代码事实
148: 
149: CP 启动 AP 的代码路径：
150: 
151: ```text
152: CP main()
153:   -> bk_init()
154:   -> bk_pm_module_vote_boot_cp1_ctrl(..., ON)
155:   -> pm_module_bootup_cpu1()
156:   -> start_cpu1_core()
157:   -> reset_cpu1_core()
158:   -> CPU1 从 AP image 启动
159: ```
160: 
161: 证据：
162: 
163: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/cp/cp_main.c:12-24`
164: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:323-374`
165: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:141-202`
166: 
167: CPU1 启动地址由 AP 分区物理地址换算得到：
168: 
169: ```c
170: logical_offset = physical_partition_offset / 34 * 32;
171: boot_address = SOC_FLASH_DATA_BASE + logical_offset;
172: ```
173: 
174: `34` 是 Flash 中 32 字节数据加 2 字节 CRC 的物理占用，代码见：
175: 
176: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:160-170`
177: - `bk_idk/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:141-174`
178: 
179: CP 设置 CPU1 power、boot address 和 software reset：
180: 
181: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:173-195`
182: - `bk_idk/middleware/soc/bk7258/soc/sys_reg.h:117-141`
183: - `bk_idk/middleware/soc/bk7258/hal/sys_hal.c:297-316`
184: 
185: 原 AP 使用 `Reset_Handler_Cpu0` 作为 AP 镜像入口，但 AP 内部第二核实际通过 `reset_cpu2_core()`启动并进入 `Reset_Handler_Cpu1`：
186: 
187: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap_bsp.ld:86-90`
188: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/startup_cpu1.c:259-318`
189: 
190: 因此，本方案先将 openvela 固件作为由物理 CPU1 引导的 AP 镜像处理。CPU2 在首版是否保持 reset 不是既定硬件事实：实施前必须确认当前启动代码、AP ready和heartbeat是否允许CPU1-only；若不允许，则阶段一就必须提供最小CPU2驻留入口或提前接入NuttX SMP。
191: 
192: ## 3. 固定地址和安全模型
193: 
194: ### 3.1 Secure 地址模型
195: 
196: 当前 AVDK 和 IDK 的 CPU1 配置均启用 `CONFIG_SPE=1`：
197: 
198: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap.defconfig:41-43`
199: - `bk_idk/middleware/soc/bk7258_cp1/bk7258_cp1.defconfig:29-31`
200: 
201: BK 地址定义使用 Secure alias：
202: 
203: - Secure Flash：`0x02000000`
204: - Secure SRAM：`0x28000000`
205: - Secure PSRAM：`0x60000000`
206: - Secure mailbox：`0x41000000` 和 `0x41020000`
207: 
208: Non-secure 视图整体增加 `0x10000000`，但本方案不使用 Non-secure 视图。openvela 固定配置为 Secure 执行环境，所有镜像、向量、外设和共享内存地址都使用 Secure alias。
209: 
210: openvela 配置含义：
211: 
212: ```text
213: CONFIG_ARCH_TRUSTZONE_DISABLED is not required
214: CONFIG_ARCH_TRUSTZONE_SECURE=y
215: CONFIG_ARMV8M_CMSE=y
216: ```
217: 
218: 这里的“Secure”仅表示首版按现有 AP 的 SPE 编译属性和 Secure alias 建立功能移植基线，不等于镜像已经通过 secure boot，也不等于 CPU1 已被限制在最小权限安全域。原 AP 的 `SystemInitCpu0()` 在 `CONFIG_SPE` 下调用 `TZ_SAU_Setup()`：
219: 
220: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/system_cpu0.c`
221: 
222: 因此 openvela 不能简单省略 SAU 步骤。实施时必须先在 golden AP 上导出 SAU、PPC/MPC/PRRO 和关键访问属性，再决定由 openvela 复现原表，还是由不可变 bootloader 预配置并锁定。IDAU 的固定归属和配置锁定规则需要 TRM 说明。
223: 
224: 当前仓库能证明存在安全工具和配置素材，但不能证明 CPU1 AP 已进入最终认证链：
225: 
226: - `bk_idk/middleware/boards/bk7258/csv/security.csv` 默认 `secureboot_en=FALSE`、`flash_aes_type=NONE`。
227: - `bk_idk/middleware/boards/bk7258/csv/otp1.csv` 定义 key hash、security counter、HUK/IAK 等字段。
228: - `bk_idk/middleware/boards/bk7258/csv/ppc.csv` 和 `mpc.csv` 提供生成素材，但默认值不是经威胁建模的最小权限策略。
229: - `bk_idk/tools/env_tools/beken_utils/scripts/partition.py` 和 `pack.py` 存在 `primary_all` 聚合与签名逻辑。
230: - 默认 BK7258 分区没有形成可复核的 BL2/TF-M/CPU1 安全构建产物，也没有 CPU1 单 bit 篡改后拒绝启动的证据。
231: 
232: 开发阶段保持与 golden CP/bootloader 相同的启动模式，不烧写不可逆 OTP/eFuse，不自行切换 Non-secure image。正式量产必须由 bootloader 提供方确认 CPU1 是独立签名对象还是 `primary_all` 子镜像，并从最终签名输入、TLV/hash范围和实板负向测试三方面证明 AP 字节被覆盖。
233: 
234: ### 3.2 Flash 分区
235: 
236: `projects/app_ab` 当前分区如下：
237: 
238: 来源：`bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/auto_partitions.csv:1-16`
239: 
240: | 分区 | 物理起始 | 物理大小 | CRC解码后的虚拟起始 | 虚拟大小 |
241: | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
242: | `primary_bootloader` | `0x000000` | `0x011000` | bootloader管理 | bootloader管理 |
243: | `primary_cp_app` | `0x011000` | `0x154000` | `0x010000` | `0x140000` |
244: | `primary_ap_app` | `0x165000` | `0x121000` | `0x150000` | `0x110000` |
245: 
246: 当前 Secure AP XIP 地址为：
247: 
248: ```text
249: SOC_FLASH_DATA_BASE + CONFIG_AP_VIRTUAL_PARTITION_OFFSET
250: = 0x02000000 + 0x00150000
251: = 0x02150000
252: ```
253: 
254: 最终链接脚本不得长期维护另一份手写地址。`0x02150000`和`0x28010000..0x28064000`只属于当前`app_ab`布局，不是BK7258固定地址。`bk_solution_ai`中的实际AI项目还在`AP_SPINLOCK`之后加入`HARDWARE_ACC`，使AP RAM起点和大小发生变化。建议由目标工程的生成结果转换出最小的 `bk7258_ap_layout.h`，只导出 AP Flash/RAM、保留区和硬件加速区必需宏，再预处理得到 `bk7258_openvela_ap.ld`。不要直接包含整个 BK `sdkconfig.h`，避免和 NuttX `nuttx/config.h` 宏冲突。生成链必须是显式依赖：
255: 
256: ```text
257: target partition CSV
258:   -> BK partition generator
259:   -> partitions_gen.h + ram_regions.h + bk_package.json
260:   -> validate/convert_bk7258_layout
261:   -> bk7258_ap_layout.h
262:   -> preprocess ld.script
263:   -> link openvela AP
264: ```
265: 
266: 干净构建必须先生成布局 header，缺文件或值与 `bk_package.json` 不一致时立即失败。
267: 
268: ### 3.3 SRAM 分区
269: 
270: 当前 `app_ab` SRAM布局来自 `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv:2-10`：
271: 
272: | 区域 | 起始地址 | 大小 | 结束地址 | 所有者 |
273: | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
274: | `AP_SPINLOCK` | `0x28000000` | `0x10000` | `0x2800ffff` | CP/AP协议保留 |
275: | `AP_RAM` | `0x28010000` | `0x54000` | `0x28063fff` | CPU1 openvela |
276: | `CP_RAM` | `0x28064000` | `0x3b700` | `0x2809f6ff` | CPU0 CP |
277: | `PWR_MNG` | `0x2809f700` | `0x100` | `0x2809f7ff` | CP/AP固定ABI |
278: | `SWAP` | `0x2809f800` | `0x800` | `0x2809ffff` | 系统保留 |
279: 
280: openvela 的主 RAM 只能是：
281: 
282: ```text
283: RAM_START = 0x28010000
284: RAM_END   = 0x28064000
285: RAM_SIZE  = 0x54000
286: ```
287: 
288: 必须禁止：
289: 
290: - 清零 CP_RAM、PWR_MNG、SWAP。
291: - 把 `AP_SPINLOCK` 放入 heap。
292: - 把 mailbox共享 buffer放入 CP_RAM或PWR_MNG。
293: - 让链接器隐式生成 `.itcm`、`.dtcm`、`.psram` alloc section。
294: 
295: ### 3.4 PSRAM所有权
296: 
297: PSRAM映射起点为 `0x60000000`。具体容量必须按目标板PSRAM型号和运行时ID确认；基础`app_ab`和AI解决方案可能分别使用不同容量，不能由芯片型号推断。PSRAM职责必须拆分为PHY/电压/时钟与ID检测、AP多媒体静态区域初始化、AP/CP heap和低功耗投票四层，不能统一描述成“全部由CP初始化”或“全部由AP初始化”。
298: 
299: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/psram/psram_driver.c:249-369`
300: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:346-382`
301: 
302: 正式规则：
303: 
304: 1. CPU1/openvela不得重复执行与CP冲突的PSRAM PHY、电压、时钟和ID检测初始化；实际执行主体由golden启动链确认。
305: 2. 若原AP在CPU1启动后初始化AP多媒体静态PSRAM区域，openvela必须实现等价步骤或通过正式PWC服务完成，不能因禁用PHY初始化而遗漏AP侧内存管理初始化。
306: 3. CPU1使用动态PSRAM前通过正式PWC协议请求/确认上电，并等待semantic response；不能假设存在独立的异步power-on广播。
307: 4. CPU1状态机确认响应成功后才启用独立PSRAM allocator/pool；不能直接复用依赖FreeRTOS的`CONFIG_PSRAM_AS_SYS_MEMORY`和`psram_malloc()`实现。
308: 5. power-off或recovery前冻结独立allocator；只有受控对象引用计数和outstanding allocation均为0时才确认断电，否则返回busy/fail。
309: 6. PSRAM初始配置为MPU normal non-cacheable；未经共享buffer一致性验证不得打开D-cache。
310: 
311: AP侧不得未经确认直接调用 `bk_psram_init()`、`bk_psram_deinit()` 或 `bk_psram_id_auto_detect()`。开工前必须从golden启动链分别确认PHY初始化、AP静态slab初始化和heap初始化的执行主体。openvela实现基于PWC请求/响应的状态机和独立allocator，不复用FreeRTOS AP的PSRAM heap接口。
312: 
313: 首个可交付版本仍然只使用AP SRAM。NuttX通用heap region注册后通常不能安全注销，也不能迁移任意调用者持有的对象，因此动态可掉电PSRAM不得直接加入通用kernel heap；它是由CP管理、由AP专用allocator控制的可选数据面。
314: 
315: ## 4. 正式启动时序
316: 
317: ### 4.1 CPU0/CP阶段
318: 
319: CP保持原代码，不改变 `projects/app_ab/cp/cp_main.c`：
320: 
321: 1. Bootloader/CP完成CPU0启动。
322: 2. CP初始化系统时钟、电源管理、UART0、CPU0侧mailbox和必要共享资源。
323: 3. CP按 `PM_BOOT_CP1_MODULE_NAME_APP`投票打开CPU1。
324: 4. CP清除CPU1 power-down。
325: 5. CP将AP逻辑起始地址写入CPU1 boot offset寄存器。写入值为 `boot_address >> 8`。
326: 6. CP选择CPU1 RXEVT路径，释放CPU1 software reset。
327: 7. CP启动CPU1后存在两套等待：IPC heartbeat任务每次最多等待2秒接收power-up indication，最多打印到`retry_cnt:4`；PWC启动路径等待`PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD`的当前常量为3000 ms，失败最多重试3次。
328: 
329: 代码依据：
330: 
331: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:323-374`
332: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:173-195`
333: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:203-220`
334: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/pwr_clk.h:26-43`
335: 
336: ### 4.2 CPU1/openvela阶段
337: 
338: CPU1 reset handler必须严格按以下顺序执行：
339: 
340: ```text
341: CPU1 boot vector
342:   1. 关闭异常和外部中断
343:   2. 使用 boot vector 提供的 MSP
344:   3. 设置 MSPLIM/栈边界
345:   4. 设置 CPU1 固定身份，不写 CPU0 身份
346:   5. 初始化 Secure CM33 基础状态
347:   6. 设置 CP10/CP11，建立 hard-float运行环境
348:   7. 初始化必要的 TCM/系统 fault 状态
349:   8. 复制 .data 和 runtime vector；首版禁止可执行 .ramfunc
350:   9. 清零 AP 私有 .bss
351:  10. 初始化 MPU
352:  11. 设置 VTOR 到 RAM runtime vector
353:  12. DSB; ISB
354:   13. 仅完成必要的低级Mailbox准备；不调用NuttX IRQ/同步API
355:  14. 调用 nx_start()，不得返回
356:       -> hardware_initialize()
357:          -> irq_initialize()调用BK up_irqinitialize()
358:          -> clock_initialize()调用SysTick lower-half
359:          -> up_initialize()注册UART；mailbox IRQ 79和transport正式目标在此时初始化
360:       -> nx_bringup()/board late
361:           -> 初始化MBOX0 channel 1 FIFO和IRQ79
362:           -> 初始化CPU1->CPU0 IPC HW_CTRL channel
363:           -> 启动IPC power-up和2秒heartbeat服务
364:           -> 创建PM worker并等待worker_ready握手
365:           -> open MB_CHNL_PWC
366:           -> 发送一次 PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD(1, 0, 0)
367: ```
368: 
369: 这个顺序的依据是：
370: 
371: - C代码调用前必须先完成SP、C runtime和FPU状态。
372: - MPU必须在NuttX访问heap和外设前建立，但runtime vector复制必须在MPU限制生效前完成或放在允许区域。
373: - VTOR必须在NVIC开启前切换，避免中断进入错误向量。
374: - reset阶段不能调用 `irq_attach()`、NuttX spinlock/semaphore或创建worker，因为 `irq_initialize()`、memory和scheduler尚未完成。mailbox必须在 `up_initialize()` 后具备完整RX/ACK能力；PWC复杂动作由PM worker执行，因为CP可能在ready后立即发送命令。
375: - 不得在 `nx_start()`返回后手工调用 `irq_initialize()`、`clock_initialize()`或 `up_initialize()`；这些步骤是上面展示的内部调用链，`nx_start()`正常情况下不返回。
376: - `nx_start()`会初始化NuttX的任务、IRQ、clock和硬件，并最终创建应用启动流程，见 `openvela/nuttx/sched/init/nx_start.c:658-826`。
377: 
378: ready的正式含义是：CPU1已经具备持续运行、响应CP IPC/PWC命令并发送heartbeat的能力，不表示NSH或所有应用已启动。CPU1必须先发送兼容Armino的IPC power-up indication；ready发送必须在NuttX调度器、Mailbox RX路径、IPC heartbeat和PM worker具备后执行，禁止只发送一个裸ready消息。
379: 
380: ### 4.3 NuttX启动阶段
381: 
382: 进入 `nx_start()`后的调用顺序：
383: 
384: ```text
385: nx_start()
386:   -> tasklist_initialize()
387:   -> memory_initialize()
388:   -> hardware_initialize()
389:        -> irq_initialize()
390:        -> clock_initialize()
391:        -> up_initialize()
392:        -> drivers_initialize()
393:        -> board_early_initialize()
394:   -> nx_bringup()
395:        -> board_late_initialize()
396:        -> nsh_main()
397: ```
398: 
399: 对应实现位置：
400: 
401: - `openvela/nuttx/sched/init/nx_start.c:757-826`
402: - `openvela/nuttx/sched/init/nx_bringup.c:293-501`
403: 
404: BK特有的CPU1身份、MPU和vector属于reset阶段；NuttX IRQ注册、UART正式设备和mailbox transport正式目标属于 `up_initialize()`；PM worker、PWC命令语义和ready发送属于board bring-up。UART不在board late重复注册。这样既符合NuttX生命周期，也保证ready发出时调度器和RX路径已可用。
405: 
406: 当前实现偏差：`bk7258_mbox_init()`（含 `irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX, ...)` 和 `up_enable_irq()`）实际在 `board_late_initialize()` -> `bk7258_pwc_start()` 中调用，而不是在 `up_initialize()` 中。`up_irqinitialize()` 只注册异常向量和设置优先级，不注册 mailbox IRQ。这意味着 mailbox RX 路径在 board late 之前不可用；如果 CP 在此窗口发送 PWC 命令，消息会堆积在 FIFO 中。后续应将 mailbox 物理层和 IRQ 注册前移到 `up_initialize()` 阶段，board late 只负责逻辑 channel open 和 worker 启动。
407: 
408: ## 5. 双向量镜像设计
409: 
410: ### 5.1 必须保留Flash boot vector
411: 
412: CPU1 boot address直接指向AP镜像起点，因此镜像offset 0必须是有效的 Cortex-M vector：
413: 
414: - word 0：AP RAM范围内的初始MSP。
415: - word 1：位于AP Flash的Thumb reset handler地址；仅凭该值不能证明Secure state。
416: 
417: 原BK镜像在offset `0x100`保留 `BK7236` legacy download magic：
418: 
419: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/startup_cpu0.c:229-231`
420: 
421: 外部IRQ向量表中的该位置会被magic覆盖，因此不能把这份Flash表作为运行时完整向量。
422: 
423: ### 5.2 RAM runtime vector
424: 
425: 正式链接脚本定义两套内容：
426: 
427: ```text
428: .bk_boot_vectors
429:   VMA/LMA: Flash image offset 0
430:   内容: MSP、Reset、bootloader magic兼容布局
431: 
432: .vectors
433:   LMA: Flash
434:   VMA: AP SRAM固定区域
435:   内容: 完整NuttX ARMv8-M向量表
436: ```
437: 
438: Reset handler完成 `.vectors` 从 Flash LMA复制到 AP SRAM VMA，然后设置 `SCB->VTOR`并执行：
439: 
440: ```c
441: __DSB();
442: __ISB();
443: ```
444: 
445: 芯片 Kconfig 必须选择 `ARCH_HAVE_CUSTOM_VECTORS`。不能直接启用NuttX通用 `CONFIG_ARCH_RAMVECTORS`，因为其实现会从当前Flash vector逐项复制：
446: 
447: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/arm_m/arm_ramvec_initialize.c:77-105`
448: 
449: 当前Flash vector含magic时，这会把magic复制成IRQ handler。正式配置关闭通用RAM vector复制，由BK7258芯片层自行完成一次独立的runtime vector安装。
450: 
451: runtime vector可按NuttX公共vector定义生成，但必须作为独立对象放入 `.ram_vectors`，不能从boot table复制：
452: 
453: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/arm_m/arm_vectors.c:102-127`
454: 
455: 链接器必须对两套vector执行512字节对齐断言，原BK脚本已有相同要求：
456: 
457: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap_bsp.ld:94-114`
458:

22: # BK7258 OpenVela AP Wi-Fi 移植实施与验证方案
23: 
24: > 文档状态：基于当前 OpenVela AP、原厂 AVDK AP/CP Wi-Fi 和 Mailbox 源码交叉验证后的实施基线。本文固定采用 W1：不修改 CPU0/CP 固件，OpenVela AP 兼容原厂 `controller_if` 协议。本文不把新建 CP bridge、socket proxy 或重新设计 descriptor ring 作为本轮交付方案。
25: 
26: ## 1. 目标和固定结论
27: 
28: ### 1.1 移植目标
29: 
30: 在物理 CPU1 单核运行的 OpenVela AP 上实现 Wi-Fi STA 基础能力，同时保持以下内容原样：
31: 
32: - CPU0/CP 固件及其 FreeRTOS 运行环境。
33: - CP 侧 Wi-Fi RWNX、UMAC/LMAC、MAC/PHY、RF、校准和共存逻辑。
34: - CP 侧 `controller_if`、`cif_ipc` 和原厂 Mailbox logical-channel wire ABI。
35: - bootloader、分区、CP 启动 AP 和 AP heartbeat/PWC 契约。
36: 
37: OpenVela AP 新增：
38: 
39: - 与原厂 `MB_CHNL_WIFI_CMD`、`MB_CHNL_WIFI_DATA` 兼容的 logical channel。
40: - 原厂 Wi-Fi command/event 协议兼容层。
41: - AP/CP 共享 Wi-Fi buffer 的地址校验、生命周期和 cache 处理。
42: - NuttX `netdev_lowerhalf` Wi-Fi 网卡 `wlan0`。
43: - NuttX wireless handlers，用于配置 SSID、密码、国家码、扫描、连接和断开。
44: - Wi-Fi transport、控制面和数据面的统计、超时与复位恢复。
45: 
46: ### 1.2 固定架构
47: 
48: ```text
49: CPU1/OpenVela AP，单核
50:   ├─ OpenVela application/socket
51:   ├─ NuttX IPv4/IPv6/TCP/UDP/DHCP/DNS
52:   ├─ BK7258 wlan0 netdev lower-half
53:   ├─ Wi-Fi control proxy
54:   └─ Wi-Fi IPC transport
55:           │
56:           │ AP→CP CMD/DATA 0x14/0x15
57:           │ CP→AP CMD/DATA 0x44/0x45
58:           │ MBOX0 + 共享 SRAM pointer/list
59:           ▼
60: CPU0/Armino CP，保持原样
61:   ├─ controller_if/cif
62:   ├─ Wi-Fi command/event handler
63:   ├─ RWNX/FHOST/UMAC/LMAC
64:   ├─ WPA/关联控制
65:   └─ Wi-Fi MAC/PHY/RF
66: ```
67: 
68: 本方案中：
69: 
70: - CPU0 是 CP，不是 OpenVela AP。
71: - CPU1 是当前 OpenVela AP primary，也是唯一启用的 AP CPU。
72: - CPU2 保持当前单核 bring-up 状态，不参与 Wi-Fi ISR、worker 或共享 buffer 管理。
73: - CP 是 Wi-Fi radio/controller 的唯一所有者。
74: - NuttX 是 AP 网络协议栈的所有者。
75: - 第一版采用 copy 接入 NuttX `netpkt_t`，不追求 NuttX packet 与 CP pbuf 零拷贝。
76: 
77: ### 1.3 本轮明确不采用的方案
78: 
79: - 不修改 CP，增加新的 Ethernet bridge 或新 ring 协议。
80: - 不把 CP Wi-Fi/RWNX 静态库链接进 OpenVela AP。
81: - 不让 OpenVela AP直接访问 Wi-Fi MAC/PHY/RF 寄存器。
82: - 不在 AP 内同时运行 Armino lwIP 和 NuttX 网络栈。
83: - 不通过 socket RPC 把全部 socket 操作代理到 CP。
84: - 不改变原厂 `MB_CHNL_WIFI_CMD`、`MB_CHNL_WIFI_DATA` 编号和 command ID。
85: - 不在第一阶段启用 SoftAP、P2P、monitor、raw link、CSI、FTM 或零拷贝。
86: - 不在第一阶段启用 CPU2 SMP。
87: 
88: ## 2. 原厂部署和代码依据
89: 
90: ### 2.1 CP 运行真实 Wi-Fi controller
91:

337: ### 3.3 Wi-Fi 接入的阻断缺口
338: 
339: | 缺失项 | 当前表现 | Wi-Fi 后果 |
340: | --- | --- | --- |
341: | Wi-Fi channel | AP TX仅有 `0x10/0x12/0x19`，AP RX仅接受 `0x42/0x49` | AP TX `0x14/0x15`、AP RX `0x44/0x45` 被拒绝 |

343: | per-channel RX callback | 只有 PWC callback | command/event/data 无接收入口 |
344: | per-channel TX-complete | 不存在 | `sending_flag` 无法清除，buffer 无法回收 |
345: | ACK queue | 单个 `g_ack_message` | burst 时 ACK 可被覆盖 |
346: | channel queue | 每通道单个 pending slot | Wi-Fi command/data 容易 `-EBUSY` |
347: | shared payload validation | 只校验 16-byte envelope | 跨核链表可能越界、循环或伪造 |
348: | pbuf compatibility | 不存在 | CP 无法理解 NuttX packet layout |
349: | command confirmation | 不存在 | scan/connect/status 无同步结果 |
350: | reset epoch | reset 只清 physical busy | 旧 pointer/ACK 可能污染新会话 |
351: | cache ownership | 只有 `dmb sy` | cache 开启后可能读到旧 descriptor/payload |
352: | NuttX netdev | 未启用网络配置和 driver | 无 `wlan0`、socket 或 DHCP |

398: ### 4.2 logical channel 扩展
399: 
400: 第一阶段将当前固定实现改成通用表：
401: 
402: ```c
403: struct bk7258_logical_channel
404: {
405:   uint8_t tx_id;
406:   uint8_t rx_id;
407:   bool opened;
408:   bool pending;
409:   mb_rx_callback_t rx;
410:   mb_tx_complete_t tx_complete;
411:   void *arg;
412:   struct mb_message tx_message;
413: };
414: ```
415: 
416: 至少注册：
417: 
418: ```text
419: HW_CTRL  0x10/0x40
420: PWC      0x12/0x42
421: WIFI_CMD AP TX/RX 0x14/0x44
422: WIFI_DATA AP TX/RX 0x15/0x45
423: UART0    0x19/0x49
424: ```
425: 
426: 实现语义必须与原厂一致：
427: 
428: - channel 值越小，物理调度优先级越高。
429: - 每个 logical command 都写入递增 `tx_seq`。
430: - transport ACK 必须匹配 logical channel 和 sequence。
431: - 无 handler 的合法通道返回 `CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL`。
432: - TX completion 只在匹配 ACK 后调用。
433: - timeout/reset 对 active transaction 回报失败，不能静默清 busy。
434: 
435: ### 4.3 Wi-Fi command transport
436: 
437: AP command 路径：
438: 
439: ```text
440: wireless_ops/ioctl
441:   -> bk7258_wifi_control_request()
442:   -> 分配 command buffer
443:   -> 填写 cmd_id/cmd_sn/payload
444:   -> cpdu_t header
445:   -> ipc_chnl_node_t(head=tail, num=1, channel=TX_BK_CMD_DATA)
446:   -> MB_CHNL_WIFI_CMD 0x14
447:   -> transport ACK
448:   -> CP command confirmation 0x44
449:   -> 按 cmd_id + sequence 唤醒等待者
450: ```
451: 
452: 必须区分：
453: 
454: - transport ACK：CP 已接管 `ipc_chnl_node_t`。
455: - command confirmation：CP 已执行业务命令并返回结果。
456: 
457: 控制请求使用 NuttX mutex + semaphore，要求：
458: 
459: - 每个请求有有界 timeout。
460: - timeout 后从 pending list 删除。
461: - CP/AP reset 时全部 pending request 返回 `-ECONNRESET`。
462: - 迟到 confirmation 只计数，不访问已释放 request。
463: - 不能在 Mailbox ISR 中阻塞。
464: 
465: ### 4.4 Wi-Fi TX 数据面
466: 
467: 由于 CP 不修改，CP 仍要求 Beken `pbuf/cpdu_t` 兼容布局。第一版在 AP 定义最小 wire-compatible TX allocation，不把 lwIP 协议栈带入 NuttX：
468: 
469: ```text
470: [wire pbuf-compatible metadata][cpdu_t][Ethernet frame]
471: ```
472: 
473: 是否必须完整复制原厂 `struct pbuf`，必须通过 CP `cif_handle_txdata()` 和实际编译配置确认。不能凭 `cpdu_t` 单独推断。正式编码前要固定：
474: 
475: - `sizeof(struct pbuf)`。
476: - payload 指针相对 pbuf/cpdu 的布局。
477: - `CONFIG_CONTROLLER_AP_BUFFER_COPY` 最终值。
478: - CP 是否修改 pbuf refcount、flags、next 和 payload。
479: - TX completion 是通过反向 `need_free` packet 还是 command confirmation。
480: 
481: 当前 `app_ab` direct-push 基线已经显示，CP 的 `cif_handle_txdata()` 会用 `head - sizeof(struct pbuf)` 还原并直接访问 AP 创建的 `struct pbuf`；TX 完成时 `cif_free_ap_txbuf()` 把同一对象的 `need_free` 置 1，再通过 CP→AP `WIFI_DATA 0x45` 返回。因此 W3 不是只兼容一个抽象的“pbuf-like metadata”，而是必须冻结并复现该最终构建所使用的完整 lwIP `struct pbuf` ABI，包括字段大小、顺序、对齐、payload 指针、refcount 和 `pbuf + 1 == cpdu` 布局。若无法证明 NuttX AP RAM 地址可被 CP 直接访问，或者无法安全复现该 ABI，则“不修改 CP”的 W1 数据面方案被阻断；不得继续靠猜测实现。
482: 
483: 依据：
484: 
485: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_wifi_dp.c:138-179`
486: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_mem_mgmt.c:8-24`

24: > 文档状态：基于当前 OpenVela AP、原厂 AVDK AP/CP Bluetooth 和 OpenVela/NuttX Bluetooth 源码交叉验证后的实施基线。本文固定采用 B1：CPU0/CP 继续运行原厂 BLE/BTDM controller-only，CPU1/OpenVela AP 使用 NuttX 原生 Bluetooth Host，通过原厂 `MB_CHNL_BT_CMD` HCI-over-Mailbox 协议通讯。本文不修改 CP，不把 Armino host静态库作为正式方案。

26: ## 1. 目标和固定结论
27: 
28: ### 1.1 移植目标
29: 
30: 在物理 CPU1 单核运行的 OpenVela AP 上实现 BLE Host，完成：
31: 
32: - HCI Command AP→CP。
33: - HCI Event CP→AP。
34: - HCI ACL 双向传输。
35: - 原厂 HCI buffer远端释放协议。
36: - NuttX Bluetooth Host初始化。
37: - BLE advertising、scan、connect、GATT read/write/notify。
38: - transport timeout、pointer校验、buffer ownership和AP/CP reset恢复。
39: 
40: 保持以下内容原样：
41: 
42: - CPU0/CP 固件。
43: - CP 的 FreeRTOS/Beken Bluetooth OS adapter。
44: - CP 的 BTDM controller-only库、RF、中断、clock、power和coexistence。
45: - CP 的 `bt_ipc_core` wire ABI。
46: - 原厂 `MB_CHNL_BT_CMD` channel ID。
47: 
48: ### 1.2 固定架构
49: 
50: ```text
51: CPU1/OpenVela AP，单核
52:   ├─ OpenVela BLE application
53:   ├─ NuttX Bluetooth Host
54:   │   ├─ GAP
55:   │   ├─ GATT
56:   │   ├─ L2CAP
57:   │   └─ SMP，后续阶段
58:   ├─ struct bt_driver_s
59:   └─ BK7258 HCI-over-Mailbox transport
60:           │
61:           │ AP→CP 0x13，CP→AP 0x43
62:           │ hci_hdr_t + 共享HCI buffer pointer
63:           ▼
64: CPU0/Armino CP，保持原样
65:   ├─ bt_ipc_core
66:   ├─ HCI adapter
67:   ├─ BTDM controller-only
68:   └─ BLE radio/RF/coexistence
69: ```
70: 
71: 本方案中：
72: 
73: - CPU0/CP 是 controller唯一所有者。
74: - CPU1/OpenVela 是 host唯一所有者。
75: - CPU2不参与 HCI ISR、worker、buffer和host状态。
76: - 第一版只支持 BLE，不支持经典 BT、SCO 和 ISO。
77: - NuttX Host与CP controller之间的边界是标准 HCI packet，不是高层 BLE RPC。
78: 
79: ### 1.3 本轮明确不采用的方案
80: 
81: - 不修改 CP 增加新 HCI ring或新协议。
82: - 不把 controller移动到 OpenVela AP。
83: - 不把 `libbluetooth_host_ble_ap.a` 作为正式 Host。
84: - 不在 CP 同时运行 Armino Host。
85: - 不使用旧 `MAILBOX_CMD_BLE_START_ADV` 等高层 RPC作为正式接口。
86: - 不将 `mb_ipc_send()` 的任意 NuttX heap pointer作为 HCI transport。
87: - 不在第一阶段支持 BR/EDR、A2DP、HFP、SPP、SCO或ISO。
88: - 不在第一阶段启用 CPU2 SMP。

168: ### 2.3 Bluetooth logical channel
169: 
170: CPU1/AP→CPU0/CP：
171: 
172: ```text
173: MB_CHNL_BT_CMD = 0x13
174: ```
175: 
176: CPU0/CP→CPU1/AP：
177: 
178: ```text
179: MB_CHNL_BT_CMD = 0x43
180: ```
181: 
182: 依据：
183: 
184: - AP：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:77-96`
185: - CP：`bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:64-83`
186: 
187: 通道值由 `CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(src_cpu, dst_cpu)` 编码，其中 bit[5:4] 是源 CPU、bit[7:6] 是目标 CPU。AP 侧 `SELF_CPU=MAILBOX_CPU1`、目标为 CPU0，所以 AP→CP 是 `0x13`；CP 侧 `SELF_CPU=MAILBOX_CPU0`、目标为 CPU1，所以 CP→AP 是 `0x43`。后续所有 TX/RX 白名单和 trace 均必须按该方向解释，不能只按宏名判断。
188: 
189: 两侧 `bt_ipc_core` 均定义：
190: 
191: ```c
192: #define BT_IPC_CMD_CHNL MB_CHNL_BT_CMD
193: ```
194: 
195: 源码：
196: 
197: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:35`
198: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:38`
199: 
200: ### 2.4 HCI wire ABI
201: 
202: 协议结构：
203: 
204: ```c
205: typedef struct __attribute__((packed))
206: {
207:     uint16_t opcode;
208:     uint8_t param_len;
209:     uint8_t param[];
210: } cmd_hdr_t;
211: 
212: typedef struct __attribute__((packed))
213: {
214:     uint8_t event_code;
215:     uint8_t param_len;
216:     uint8_t param[];
217: } event_hdr_t;
218: 
219: typedef struct __attribute__((packed))
220: {
221:     uint16_t hdl_flags;
222:     uint16_t datalen;
223:     uint8_t param[];
224: } acl_hdr_t;
225: 
226: typedef struct __attribute__((packed))
227: {
228:     mb_chnl_hdr_t hdr;
229:     uint8_t pkt_type;
230:     uint32_t hdr_ptr;
231: } hci_hdr_t;
232: ```
233: 
234: 定义：
235: 
236: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/include/bt_ipc_core.h:24-77`
237: 
238: packet type：
239: 
240: ```text
241: HCI_COMMAND_PKT  = 0x01
242: HCI_ACL_DATA_PKT = 0x02
243: HCI_SCO_DATA_PKT = 0x03
244: HCI_EVENT_PKT    = 0x04
245: HCI_FREE_PKT     = 0x0a
246: ```
247: 
248: 定义：
249: 
250: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/include/bt_ipc_core.h:79-86`
251: 
252: `hci_hdr_t` 本身是 packed 结构，在线 ABI 下应为 9 字节：4 字节 `mb_chnl_hdr_t`、1 字节 `pkt_type`、4 字节 `hdr_ptr`，`hdr_ptr` 的 offset 应为 5。它被放入 16 字节 `bt_ipc_cmd_t/mb_chnl_cmd_t` union，通过 logical channel传输；剩余 7 字节没有协议字段，发送实现必须初始化整个 16 字节对象，避免跨核泄露未初始化栈内容。实际 HCI payload位于 `hdr_ptr` 指向的发送方 heap/shared buffer。B0 阶段必须由 AP 和 CP 各自使用实际工具链验证 `sizeof/offsetof`，不能仅依赖文档推算。
253: 
254: ### 2.5 AP→CP HCI
255: 
256: 原 AP 为 command/ACL/SCO 分配独立 buffer，再通过 `hdr_ptr` 发送：
257: 
258: - Command：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:201-223`
259: - ACL：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:249-271`
260: - SCO：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:273-295`
261: 
262: 发送前通过 semaphore串行化，每次 logical TX completion释放 semaphore：
263: 
264: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:145-175`
265: 
266: CP 收到 HCI command/ACL 后复制到本地 H4 packet并交给 controller HCI callback：
267: 
268: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:360-401`
269: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:414-435`
270: 
271: ### 2.6 CP→AP HCI
272: 
273: CP 发送 Event/ACL/SCO，并以 pointer承载 payload：
274: 
275: - Event：`bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:228-250`
276: - ACL：`bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:252-274`
277: - SCO：`bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:276-298`
278: 
279: 原 AP 收到后将 Event/ACL/SCO 复制成带 H4 type 的本地 buffer，再调用 host HCI callback：
280: 
281: - Event：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:348-388`
282: - ACL：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:391-413`
283: - SCO：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:416-438`
284: 
285: ### 2.7 Buffer释放协议
286: 
287: 接收方处理完远端 payload后发送：
288: 
289: ```text
290: pkt_type = HCI_FREE_PKT
291: hdr_ptr  = 原始远端 pointer
292: ```
293: 
294: 发送：
295: 
296: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:297-305`
297: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:300-308`
298: 
299: 原分配方收到 `HCI_FREE_PKT` 后执行本地 free：
300: 
301: - AP：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:441-446`
302: - CP：`bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:464-469`
303: 
304: 因此至少存在三种不同完成语义：
305: 
306: 1. Mailbox transport ACK：16-byte descriptor已被对端 logical layer接收。
307: 2. `HCI_FREE_PKT`：对端已经复制/消费 payload，原分配方可以 free。
308: 3. HCI Command Complete/Status或 Number Of Completed Packets：controller协议处理结果。
309: 
310: 三者不能互相替代。

14: 
15: #ifdef CONFIG_DEV_GPIO
16: struct bk7258_button_gpio_s
17: {
18:   struct gpio_dev_s gpio;
19:   uint8_t id;
20: };
21: #endif
22: 
23: void bk7258_gpio_input_pullup(unsigned int pin);
24: bool bk7258_gpio_read(unsigned int pin);
25: 
26: static const uint8_t g_button_pins[NUM_BUTTONS] =
27: {
28:   BOARD_KEY_VOLUME_UP_GPIO,
29:   BOARD_KEY_POWER_GPIO,
30:   BOARD_KEY_VOLUME_DOWN_GPIO,
31: };
32: 
33: #ifdef CONFIG_DEV_GPIO
34: static int bk7258_button_read(struct gpio_dev_s *dev, bool *value);
35: 
36: static const struct gpio_operations_s g_button_ops =
37: {
38:   .go_read = bk7258_button_read,
39:   .go_write = NULL,
40:   .go_attach = NULL,
41:   .go_enable = NULL,
42: };
43: 
44: static struct bk7258_button_gpio_s g_button_gpio[NUM_BUTTONS];
45: 
46: static int bk7258_button_read(struct gpio_dev_s *dev, bool *value)
47: {
48:   struct bk7258_button_gpio_s *button =
49:     (struct bk7258_button_gpio_s *)dev;
50: 
51:   *value = !bk7258_gpio_read(g_button_pins[button->id]);
52:   return OK;
53: }
54: #endif
55: 
56: uint32_t board_button_initialize(void)
57: {
58:   unsigned int i;
59: 
60:   for (i = 0; i < NUM_BUTTONS; i++)
61:     {
62:       bk7258_gpio_input_pullup(g_button_pins[i]);
63: #ifdef CONFIG_DEV_GPIO
64:       g_button_gpio[i].gpio.gp_pintype = GPIO_INPUT_PIN;
65:       g_button_gpio[i].gpio.gp_ops = &g_button_ops;

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 PWC worker and CPU1 ready handshake.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: #include <stdint.h>
7: #include <stdbool.h>
8: 
9: #include <nuttx/semaphore.h>
10: #include <nuttx/sched.h>
11: #include <nuttx/signal.h>
12: #include <nuttx/kthread.h>
13: #include <nuttx/clock.h>
14: 
15: int bk7258_mailbox_init(void);
16: int bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(uint8_t command, uint32_t p1, uint32_t p2,
17:                             uint32_t p3);
18: void bk7258_mailbox_set_pwc_rx(void (*callback)(const void *message));
19: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
20: 
21: #define PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD 0x5u
22: #define PM_QUEUE_DEPTH 8u
23: 
24: struct pwc_message
25: {
26:   uint32_t header;
27:   uint32_t param1;
28:   uint32_t param2;
29:   uint32_t param3;
30: };
31: 
32: static struct pwc_message g_queue[PM_QUEUE_DEPTH];
33: static volatile unsigned int g_head;
34: static volatile unsigned int g_tail;
35: static sem_t g_pwc_sem;
36: static sem_t g_worker_sem;
37: static volatile bool g_worker_ready;
38: static volatile bool g_ready_sent;
39: 
40: static int ipc_heartbeat_worker(int argc, char **argv)
41: {
42:   static uint32_t heartbeat_payload;
43: 
44:   (void)argc;
45:   (void)argv;
46:   for (;;)
47:     {
48:       nxsig_usleep(2000000);
49:       (void)bk7258_mbox_send_message(2, 0x10,
50:                                      (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)&heartbeat_payload,
51:                                      sizeof(heartbeat_payload), 0);
52:     }
53:   return 0;
54: }
55: 
56: static void pwc_rx(const void *raw)
57: {
58:   const uint8_t *bytes = raw;
59:   struct pwc_message message;
60:   unsigned int next = (g_head + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
61:   if (next == g_tail || bytes == NULL)
62:     {
63:       return;
64:     }
65:   message.header = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[0];
66:   message.param1 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[1];
67:   message.param2 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[2];
68:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
69:   g_queue[g_head] = message;
70:   g_head = next;
71:   nxsem_post(&g_pwc_sem);
72: }
73: 
74: static int pwc_worker(int argc, char **argv)
75: {
76:   (void)argc;
77:   (void)argv;
78:   g_worker_ready = true;
79:   nxsem_post(&g_worker_sem);
80:   for (;;)
81:     {
82:       struct pwc_message message;
83:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_pwc_sem);
84:       message = g_queue[g_tail];
85:       g_tail = (g_tail + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
86:       /* Hardware power/clock actions stay in this thread, never in IRQ. */
87:       switch (message.header & 0xffu)
88:         {
89:           case 0x7u: /* PSRAM power request: CP owns the PHY transition. */
90:           case 0xau: /* AP recovery request. */
91:           case 0x8u: /* allocator state query. */
92:           case 0x9u: /* allocator diagnostics query. */
93:             break;
94:           default:
95:             break;
96:         }
97:     }
98:   return 0;
99: }
100: 
101: int bk7258_pwc_start(void)
102: {
103:   int pid;
104:   nxsem_init(&g_pwc_sem, 0, 0);
105:   nxsem_init(&g_worker_sem, 0, 0);
106:   g_head = 0;
107:   g_tail = 0;
108:   g_worker_ready = false;
109:   g_ready_sent = false;
110:   pid = bk7258_mailbox_init();
111:   if (pid < 0)
112:     {
113:       return pid;
114:     }
115:   bk7258_mailbox_set_pwc_rx(pwc_rx);
116:   /* Match Armino mb_ipc_heartbeat: notify CPU0 before PM ready and keep the
117:    * CPU1 liveness indication independent from the PWC worker. */
118:   if (bk7258_mbox_send_message(1, 0x10, 0, 0, 0) != 0)
119:     {
120:       return -1;
121:     }
122:   if (kthread_create("ipc-heartbeat", 100, 1536, ipc_heartbeat_worker,
123:                      NULL) < 0)
124:     {
125:       return -1;
126:     }
127:   pid = kthread_create("pwc", 110, 2048, pwc_worker, NULL);
128:   if (pid < 0)
129:     {
130:       return pid;
131:     }
132:   if (nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_worker_sem, MSEC2TICK(200)) < 0 ||
133:       !g_worker_ready)
134:     {
135:       return -ETIMEDOUT;
136:     }
137:   if (!g_ready_sent)
138:     {
139:       g_ready_sent = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD, 1, 0, 0) == 0;
140:     }
141:   return g_ready_sent ? 0 : -1;
142: }

### Status vocabulary

- **Board-mounted**: component shown as populated circuitry on the AIDK PCB.
- **External/connector**: board exposes a connector/pads, but the actual sensor, microphone, speaker, or panel is external.
- **Chip-only**: BK7258 contains the controller/analog block, but the AIDK schematic does not prove a corresponding mounted peripheral.
- **Armino supported**: the factory `bk_solution_ai`/AVDK configuration has an enabled driver or service.
- **OpenVela supported**: implemented and enabled in the current `bk7258-ap` NuttX configuration—not merely proposed in a porting plan.

## OpenVela BSP support summary

The current OpenVela port is a **minimal CPU1 AP bring-up BSP**, not yet the multimedia/connectivity BSP represented by `bk_solution_ai`.

- TX-only console forwarding through the CP UART0 mailbox channel.
- Basic GPIO.
- Three active-low board buttons, polling/read interface.
- PWM and the power-key vibration-motor behavior.

## Important ambiguities that require physical verification

1. **Exact SoC ordering code:**  
   The schematic only identifies `BK7258_QFN88_9X9`. The 8 MB partition map plus 16 MB PSRAM layout strongly imply the QFN88 8 MB flash/16 MB PSRAM option, corresponding to the datasheet’s `BK7258QN88616`, but the actual package marking or BOM is needed for certainty.

2. **SD NAND capacity:**  
   Schematic sheet 1 says **1 GB**; Beken Genie README says **128 MB**. U7 presence is certain, capacity is not.

3. **Camera mounting:**  
   Software calls the target GC2145, but the schematic shows a generic 24-pin DVP connector and explicitly supports multiple sensor voltages. Therefore GC2145 is a supported external module, not proven soldered directly to the main AIDK PCB.

4. **Microphone and speaker population:**  
   The connectors and analog circuitry are present, but the transducers themselves are external. MIC2 also contains `NC` coupling components and should not be assumed operational without checking assembly population.

5. **RF population:**  
   Both a PCB-mounted antenna footprint and IPEX/U.FL path are shown with `NC`/0 Ω selection components. The exact populated antenna path must be checked on the board.

6. **OpenVela “UART1” naming:**  
   `/dev/ttyS1` exists, but it is currently a mailbox-backed TX sink to CP UART0—not a direct, bidirectional UART1 implementation.
